Larger storage buffer experiment — 2026-10-19

Image: fuse-vault-buffer-635k-ram-debug.uf2
SHA-256: 56c3c5ca3c0552b94354df13be77be9c5e7cb943ee093728f14bc51447ad7769
Source: d7c5206 plus local OTP routing and larger USB-buffer changes.
Build directory: build-board-buffer-test; FV_USB_IO_BYTES=65024.

Both USB endpoint and worker buffers increase from 32768 to 65024 bytes:
63.5 KiB each, 63 KiB extra total. Exactly 64 KiB cannot fit TinyUSB's
16-bit transfer length. Vault operations retain their 64-sector limit;
each larger worker request is split into at most 64 + 63 sectors. Failed
sub-batches stop the request, and success is returned only after all finish.
This experiments with USB/worker overlap, not larger SD/crypto operations.
Firmware defaults remain 32 KiB; only this experimental build selects 65024.

Physical display, UI, storage and FIDO remain on. RAM/debug screen and OTP
inspection remain on, matching the baseline. Other debug flags remain off.
Vault, passkeys and OTP formats are unchanged; do not create a new vault.

Safely eject the mounted vault before BOOTSEL flashing. Reconnect and unlock.
The existing viewer reconnects automatically. Use the same source file,
cipher configuration, connector and viewer for comparison. Copy to a fresh
filename with enough space; time until the copy finishes its final flush.
Compare the steady device upload rate against the previous ~500 KiB/s.
After safe eject/reconnect, verify the copied file and check FIDO still works.

Expected fixed RAM: 428.1 KiB (was 365.1 KiB). With the observed 14.9 KiB
heap reservation, uncommitted RAM should be about 77 KiB (was 140 KiB).
Actual performance and runtime RAM figures still require hardware testing.

Validation:
- Full firmware cross-build passed; UF2 identity/address range checked.
- ELF confirms two 65024-byte buffers and +64512 bytes fixed allocation.
- Five targeted host tests passed, using the existing ASan/UBSan build.
- Actual patched TinyUSB BOT driver tests passed under ASan/UBSan with
  4096, 16384, 32768 and 65024-byte buffers, covering overlap, delayed
  completion, failure, reset and durable final write acknowledgement.
- New worker tests cover split reads/writes, failures in either sub-batch,
  whole-request bounds validation and locked-vault rejection.

Baseline for rollback: fuse-vault-d7c5206-ram-debug.uf2 in this directory.
